correctness.rationale: The 16-vertex shortest-path geometry gives exactly 336 forbidden triples and the complete (16,120,224,220,80) face vector. The replayed 227-pair elementary collapse certificate leaves (16,85,77,28) faces. Signed integer boundaries square to zero and admit exact unimodular-only Smith reductions of ranks (15,46,27), with all nonzero invariant factors one. Therefore all reduced integral homology is torsion-free and has ranks 24,4,1 in degrees 1,2,3. Full standard-library check.py and collapses.json are embedded.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The GP complex is precisely the independence complex of the 336-edge geodesic-betweenness 3-uniform hypergraph. The same-graph two-independence and geodesic complexes are not equivalent: one forbids only two-edge graph paths while the other forbids all metric-between triples. Their simplices, dimensions and homology are not interchangeable.

value.rationale: The canonical 16-vertex symmetric cubic Levi graph of the (8_3) configuration yields a natural finite geodesic complex with torsion-free integral homology in three distinct positive degrees; this is a complete homological classification of that object. Its nonzero third homology and additional second homology are not derivable from general-position numbers or face counts. It provides a concrete structural topological benchmark without unsupported claims about larger families or downstream general theorems.
